officer_hongkong.delivery: low and honeyed, Portuguese-accented English; charming and close, with a blade under every compliment
officer_hongkong.catchphrase: I know every hiding place on a ship, Captain. I built half of them.
officer_hongkong.bio: Isabel grew up on her father's lorchas, running opium and silver past the Macau forts. When the Rebelos were finally caught, the British offered his clever daughter a choice: a cell, or a desk on the Hong Kong wharves. She chose the desk, and every smuggler on the coast has regretted it since.
officer_hongkong.quirk: Leans across the desk to read your manifest upside down while she smiles at you.
officer_hongkong.vice: Port wine from home, fast boats, and captains who think they're cleverer than her.
officer_hongkong.secret: Her father still runs boats out of Macau, and his cargo crosses her wharf untaxed.
